description: Look up eBay seller feedback, seller reputation, Detailed Seller Ratings, replies and store metadata by username or store URL.

feedbackType.description: Which side of the seller's feedback ledger to read.
feedbackType.sectionDescription: Optional filters applied to the feedback list. The rating and period filters are applied by eBay where possible and checked again in the actor.
feedbackType.title: Feedback role

imagesOnly.description: Return only feedback entries where the buyer attached a photo.
imagesOnly.title: Only feedback with photos

includeAutomated.description: Include eBay's automated positive feedback entries. Turn off to keep only feedback written by buyers.
includeAutomated.title: Include automated feedback

includePhotos.description: Fetch every buyer photo for feedback entries that have more than one. Adds one public feedback-detail request per such entry.
includePhotos.title: Include full photo galleries

itemSearch.description: Only feedback for matching items. eBay searches the last 5 years and cannot combine this with its period or rating filters; the rating filter is checked by the actor instead.
itemSearch.title: Item title or ID search

marketplace.description: eBay site used for plain usernames and as the default for store URLs.
marketplace.sectionDescription: Choose the eBay site whose language, currency and feedback profile you want to read.
marketplace.title: Marketplace

maxFeedbackPerSeller.description: Per-seller cap. The global maxItems cap also applies.
maxFeedbackPerSeller.title: Max feedback rows per seller

maxItems.description: Maximum number of feedback rows to return across all sellers.
maxItems.sectionDescription: Control how many rows and pages are collected.
maxItems.title: Max feedback rows

maxPages.description: Safety cap on feedback pages followed per seller. eBay usually serves 25, 50 or 100 rows per page.
maxPages.title: Max pages per seller

mode.description: Choose feedback rows, one seller profile summary per seller, or both.
mode.title: Mode

period.description: Only feedback left in this period. eBay applies this within the last 12 months.
period.title: Period

sellerUsernames.description: eBay seller usernames or profile URLs, e.g. "musicmagpie" or https://www.ebay.com/usr/musicmagpie. At least one of sellerUsernames or storeUrls must be given.
sellerUsernames.title: Seller usernames

sortBy.description: Newest first is best for monitoring; relevance follows eBay's own ranking.
sortBy.title: Sort order

stopAtFeedbackIds.description: Optional feedback IDs from an earlier run. Each seller stops when one of these IDs is reached (the known row is not returned). Requires newest-first sorting.
stopAtFeedbackIds.title: Stop at known feedback IDs

storeUrls.description: Full eBay store URLs (https://www.ebay.com/str/<seller>). The URL's eBay site is used for that seller.
storeUrls.title: Store URLs

title: eBay Seller Feedback Scraper Input
